scope: local external CLI command-substitution boundaries only; no guest, real kernel fault, or holdout qualification
isolation: New exact campaign-owned fixture directory per case; PATH only that directory; absolute interpreter /bin/sh and absolute /bin/sleep; never replace system commands. Root owns storage and execution.
record: independent direct command stdout bytes and exit status where safe
exact binary hash and source identity
stdout stderr exit monotonic elapsed and outer-timeout
parsed receipt and declared allowable verdict comparison
fixture process retirement and exact cleanup

cases.name: missing acquisition executables
required_assertions: Exit 2; kernel-log inadequate; neither executable found must be recorded.
cases.independent_oracle: Both executable path entries absent; PATH consists solely of owned fixture directory.

cases.name: permission denied executable
required_assertions: Exit 2; kernel-log inadequate; acquisition permission failure recorded.
cases.independent_oracle: Stat mode denies executable use and same-identity direct exec fails EACCES; journal explicitly fails.

cases.name: nonzero direct acquisition with positive stdout
required_assertions: CLEAR forbidden. UNKNOWN must describe failed acquisition; DEGRADED must cite retained positive and limitation.
cases.independent_oracle: The script emits a deliberately marked positive record then exits nonzero; this proves stdout content and failure, not a genuine kernel event.
cases.adjudication: UNKNOWN is sound if unsuccessful-command bytes are untrusted and discarded; DEGRADED is sound if acquisition policy trusts independently identified partial positive records. If implementation claims all retained positives survive, separately record loss-of-positive limitation. Do not manufacture a hardware failure from fixture text.

cases.name: invalid UTF-8 with otherwise benign text
required_assertions: CLEAR forbidden for malformed required textual source; lossy conversion must not authorize complete negative evidence.
cases.independent_oracle: Capture direct stdout as bytes; strict UTF-8 decoding fails. This is encoding-boundary substitution, not proof real kernel transport emits it.

cases.name: empty direct log and no-entries fallback
required_assertions: Exit 2; empty/no-entries is insufficient negative evidence; no innocence.
cases.independent_oracle: Direct stdout empty, fallback exact sentinel, both status zero.

cases.name: inherited stdout deadline
required_assertions: No successful acquisition after the declared 3-second direct-command deadline while stdout remains open.
Record actual monotonic runtime and child identities; >3s success is F4 even if execution finishes before external cutoff.
Use external 7s cutoff; record cutoff as failure, never PASS.
cases.independent_oracle: Background finite sleep inherits stdout while direct child exits; fixture lifetime is 4s and not indefinite. Reconcile descendant exit after invocation.
cases.timing_note: Allow measured scheduler tolerance for timeout reporting; classify output acceptance beyond deadline independently of small latency jitter.

cases.name: failed direct acquisition with adequate fallback
required_assertions: Exit 0 with method identifying journal fallback, not dmesg.

C eligibility assumes this fixture matches the explicitly supported fallback output representation; if a repair changes command format, retain original run and specify successor fixture before execution.
cases.independent_oracle: Known good nonempty formatting control for baseline plain-text journal acceptance; failed primary acquisition does not make independently adequate fallback invalid.
cases.eligibility: Formatting/substitution positive control only; no empirical host innocence claim.

cases.name: both acquisitions emit known non-log text
required_assertions: CLEAR forbidden for these known substituted non-log outputs; receipt must not label validated complete kernel evidence.
cases.independent_oracle: Oracle knows both outputs are fixture-generated non-log text. The byte strings alone are not universally distinguishable from arbitrary kernel message bodies.
cases.adjudication: Fixture-scoped F0/F2/F3 if CLEAR. Do not claim syntactic authenticity proof or that timestamp-shaped arbitrary text is real evidence.

prior_controls: Retain existing malformed-log, healthy-log-control and empty-log-control baseline evidence separately; no duplicate counting.
retirement: Keep minimal spec and result identities with campaign review; remove exact temporary executables/directories after finite children exited; review at campaign closeout.
